articles.summary: ATLANTA, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Katapult Holdings, Inc. (“Katapult Holdings” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: KPLT), a scaled, technology and data-driven platform serving nonprime consumers seeking greater financial flexibility, today announced it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, November 12, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss these results at 8:00 AM ET that same day. A live audio webcast of the conference call will be available on the Katapult Holdings Investor Relations website at https://ir.katapultholdings.com . A replay will be available on the investor relations website following the call. About Katapult Holdings, Inc. Katapult Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: KPLT) is a scaled, technology and data-driven platform serving nonprime consumers seeking greater financial flexibility.
